blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Montenegro Shipping Lines Inc. has temporarily suspended its ferry trips from Odiongan town in Romblon, to Batangas on Friday (Nov. 6), according to a travel advisory. The advisory did not specify the reason for the suspension. READ: More int’l shipping lines calling on Batangas port Affected passengers were advised to contact Montenegro Shipping Lines directly to confirm the next sailing schedule and other travel arrangements before proceeding to the port. Passengers were also urged to monitor official announcements for further updates. The suspension may affect travelers planning to travel between Romblon and mainland Luzon through the […]...
